subject: Next steps: demo + technical deep dive and onramp meeting

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: 
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + next steps

Hi Alex — great conversation today, thanks for walking through the HealthSync ingestion and dedup flows. Quick recap and a clear next step so we can keep momentum: 

- What we heard: you want a low-latency document normalization service powered by an LLM to extract and canonicalize provider/patient metadata. Primary constraints are PII handling (redaction at rest), 95th-percentile response time under 350ms for single-document inference, and throughput of ~50 reqs/s per model.

- Success criteria for evaluation (proposed):
  • extraction accuracy >= 92% on your seed prompt set
  • end-to-end latency (API -> model -> postprocess) 95th <= 350ms
  • cost target <$0.015 per document at target throughput

Next step: schedule a combined demo + technical deep dive where we can: walk an end-to-end request path, review model/quantization recommendations, and map the trial plan (data handling, eval prompt set, and timeline). I’m proposing a 60–75 minute session so we can cover both product and infra.

Available slots (PDT):
  • Mon 8/31 10:00–11:15am
  • Tue 9/1 1:00–2:15pm
  • Wed 9/2 9:00–10:15am

I’ve attached a one-page trial charter that outlines proposed milestones, responsibilities, and what we’d need from your side (example prompt set + small sample data export). If you prefer, we can also split demo and infra deep dive into two shorter calls.

Can you confirm which slot works and whether to include your engineering lead? I’ll loop in Ben to coordinate scheduling and prework.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0198
